topic: Google Cloud Agent Substrate on GKE
facts_used: Google Cloud announced Agent Substrate availability on GKE on 2026-09-15.
Google states 10x higher sandbox density than standard container runtimes.
Google states sub-500ms resume operations at more than 500 suspend/resume activations per second.
Idle agents can be suspended so CPU and memory can be released for active workloads.
Production support is currently allowlist-based under a limited/private GA program; evaluation and non-production use are broadly available.
caveat: Performance figures are Google engineering claims, not an independent benchmark; actual performance depends on workload. Production support is allowlist-based.
post_text:
AIエージェント、賢さだけ見てると足りんかもしれん。

Google CloudがAgent SubstrateをGKEで公開。
Google発表では10倍の密度、500ms未満で再開。

増やすほど、モデルより「待機・隔離・再開」まで含めた実行基盤の設計が大事になってきた。

ただし、本番サポートは現状allowlist。
